question: In the Q&A for an external audit RFP for a retirement system whose general ledger system is Microsoft Dynamics SL, what were the total contractual fees for the prior year (FY2021) audits?
expected_facts: $73,000 (Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System, RFP 515-22-300 Q&A).
acceptance: $73,000 for FY2021 audits suffices; issuer/RFP number optional.

prior_reviews.reason: The document is a 2024 actuarial-services RFP issued by Apple Valley Fire Protection District, not a Q&A for an external audit RFP for the specified retirement system. It gives no FY2021 audit contractual fees.
quotes: The Apple Valley Fire Protection District is accepting proposals from qualified consultants for Actuarial Services
